digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge public interfaces (CLI, library, MCP)
propositions: Typed library functions (bridge_preview, bridge_sync, bridge_status, bridge_pause, bridge_resume, bridge_check_access) must be exported and reuse the shared run_pass classification helper with canonical route/disposition mapping.

MCP tools for new bridge operations must register with explicit typed inputs/outputs and outputSchema while existing reconcile(mode=...) and bridge_fsck tools retain their published names and contracts.

rebar.reconcile(mode=...) must remain exported with dry-run default and accepted mode values, mapped semantically to new bridge operations without changing published return type, exception behavior, or mutation boundary.
Every mutating MCP route (bridge_sync, bridge_pause, bridge_resume, legacy reconcile modes) must be gated by mcp.allow_jira_sync; read-only routes must not be rejected by this gate.
Compatibility adapters must preserve legacy defaults, mutation boundaries, and external contracts; preview must never silently become sync.

CLI, library, and MCP surfaces must be tested for semantic disposition parity and authorization contrast, with documentation updated to present noun-based bridge operations as primary while explaining retained legacy entrypoints.
